purpose: Git-tracked order-2 effective-numerator day-comparison snapshot used to hold the 2024-12-06 readout shape fixed while testing 2024-12-05 detector-state nuisance freedom

provenance.note: Derived diagnostic snapshot. Effective numerator coefficients are magnitude-shape coordinates, not identified hardware components.

day_shape_repeatability.note: Rounded descriptive values retained only for provenance; the detector-state diagnostic recomputes its own model-vs-target metrics.

guardrail: Use the reference_order2 transfer as a fixed effective readout shape only. The snapshot does not identify a physical electronics transfer, and the repeat detector operating point remains inherited rather than independently measured.
